subject: Hybrid lab day — access, AV/recording consent, and routing/load plan
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridian.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@veridian.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: shift hands-on lab to hybrid - facility access & recording

Hi Laura,

We're looking to convert the onsite POC day we booked for Dec 22 into a hybrid session. A couple of constraints on our side: a) about 8 people will be onsite (ID badge required), b) several engineers will dial in from remote offices and need screen share + low-latency routing to the Redwood test model, and c) our security team needs an access form and an initial list of egress IPs for permitting.

Can your team confirm you can run the routing/load test during the session (simulate 200 concurrent prompt streams for 90s bursts)? Also we need to understand your recording policy for demos — we can allow recordings but redaction/limited retention is required.

I've attached our site access form and the building visitor instructions. If we can get a short runbook (1-2 pages) for room AV + who to ping on arrival, that'd help our facilities team.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Rao
Sr. Platform Engineer, Veridian Logistics
Attachment: veridian_site_access_form.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridian.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: shift hands-on lab to hybrid - facility access & recording

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up. We can support a hybrid format, and we can run a short load/reliability test as part of the session. A few quick asks so we can finalize the runbook: 

- Final attendee headcount (onsite vs remote) and any VIPs who need early access.
- Visitor badge lead time and the point of contact at Veridian reception (name/phone).
- Network constraints: are outbound policies restrictive (e.g., only specific IP ranges)? We need to confirm our test VM egress IPs.
- Recording: we can record the session to our secure S3 bucket and provide an expiring link. We can optionally redact logs/SSNs if you flag timestamps. Please confirm retention window (we typically do 30 days unless you need shorter).

Proposed schedule options (pick one):
1) Dec 22, 09:30–13:00 local — onsite arrival 09:00, 2-hour working block with 30-min load test at 11:00.
2) Dec 23, 13:00–16:30 local — onsite arrival 12:30, load test at 15:00.

If either works, we'll publish a short runbook and a one-hour tech dry-run for our infra team two days prior.

Looping in Stephanie (eng lead) and Connor (ops) to map hardware and access.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: shift hands-on lab to hybrid - facility access & recording (internal planning)

Marcus / Connor — quick internal plan before we send the runbook to Veridian.

- Marcus: can you prepare a reduced quant/FP16 variant of the model for the in-room GPU so we can prioritize latency for onsite attendees? We'll keep the hosted variant for remote attendees to avoid bandwidth spikes.
- Connor: can you produce an egress IP list and confirm we can spin up the load harness to generate 200 concurrent prompt streams from our staging cluster? Aim for 90s bursts, three iterations. Provide start/stop hooks so we can abort quickly.
- I'll draft a 2-page runbook (AV checklist, guest arrival steps, recording consent line, contact matrix). Laura — if you want to include any customer-facing wording re: retention, flag it and I'll bake it in.

Timeline: runbook draft by EOD Wed, dry-run on Dec 20 10:00–11:00 PT, final runbook updated and attached to calendar invite.

Stephanie Nguyen
Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridian.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@veridian.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: shift hands-on lab to hybrid - facility access & recording

Laura — thanks, that timeline works. Final details:

- Onsite: 8 people (4 eng, 2 product, 2 facilities). Remote: ~10 engineers across two regions.
- Reception lead: Maya Ortiz, +1-415-555-0198 — she'll hold badges when you arrive.
- Retention: 7 days is ideal for us. Please mark any session transcripts containing customer data for redaction (we'll flag after the session).
- Network: we've opened a temporary outbound rule for the IPs in your network-egress-ip-list.txt (attached).

We uploaded the signed site access form and a short facilities FAQ. Also posted a Zoom bridge (below) that attendees should use if they dial in.

Attachment: veridian_site_access_form.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridian.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Final runbook & calendar — Veridian hybrid session (Dec 22, 09:30–13:00)

Samir / Emily — confirmed for Dec 22, 09:30–13:00 PT with onsite arrival at 09:00. Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is our 2-page runbook (redwood_lab_runbook_v2.pdf) and the egress IP list we asked for (network-egress-ip-list.txt). Highlights: 

- Arrival: Check in with Maya Ortiz at reception; Laura or Connor will collect badges.
- AV: We'll bring a laptop + HDMI split; Marcus will connect the model host to the local switch. Please ensure boardroom AV supports 'presenter' input and a room mic.
- Recording: Redwood will record the main session and post an expiring link valid for 7 days per your request. We will redact any flagged timestamps within that window; please email redaction requests to legal@redwood.com.
- Load test: 11:00 local — three 90s bursts at 200 concurrent prompt streams. Marcus will coordinate start/stop.
- Dry-run: Dec 20, 10:00–11:00 PT (internal + Veridian infra). Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=example

Next steps for Veridian: send final guest list (names + company ID numbers) by EOD Dec 21; confirm reception contact if it changes. We'll send calendar invites and attach the runbook + access form.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_lab_runbook_v2.pdf, network-egress-ip-list.txt
